name: KUI
tagline: A simple desktop app for Apache Kafka.
description: See your topics, read and send messages, and check how far behind your consumers are, without a single CLI flag. Built in Rust with Tauri, so it starts fast, needs no JVM or server, and keeps your connection settings on your computer.
features: List, search (⌘K), create and delete topics
Read newest or oldest messages, or watch them arrive live
Send your own messages or generate test data
See which consumer groups are caught up and which are behind
SSL and SASL clusters work too
